evals.prompt: Use $url-reader to read https://twitter.com/nikkei/status/1524011459130314752 and return JSON fields that would be useful for a Notion knowledge workflow.
evals.expected_output: The script normalizes the URL to x.com, uses the X oEmbed backend, extracts post text and author metadata, and returns a stable JSON object.
assertions: normalized_url starts with https://x.com/nikkei/status/1524011459130314752
reader_backend is x_oembed
reader_status is Extracted or Partial
markdown contains the public post text
image_links is empty or the response explicitly explains that X oEmbed does not provide media URLs

evals.prompt: Use $url-reader to read https://x.com/claudecode84/article/2072546601789428152 and return its Markdown and image links for a Notion knowledge page.
evals.expected_output: The script preserves the X Article URL as the normalized and source URL, reads it through the generic reader, and returns Article Markdown and image links when available.
assertions: normalized_url and source_url remain https://x.com/claudecode84/article/2072546601789428152
reader_backend is generic_reader or browser4 when the Article retrieval succeeds
the Article URL remains the retrieval URL; no derived status URL is required
when generic_reader and Browser4 remain incomplete, browser_fallback.required is true and surface is in_app_browser
markdown contains the public Article text without replacing the Article source URL
image_links contains extracted public image URLs when the Article exposes images

evals.prompt: Use $url-reader to read a public Instagram post URL and download any extracted images to a temporary directory.
evals.expected_output: The script uses the generic reader path, preserves the source URL, extracts caption or metadata when available, and records downloaded image paths or per-image errors.
assertions: reader_backend is generic_reader
reader_status is one of Extracted, Partial, ImagesOnly, Blocked, or Failed
downloaded_images contains paths for successful downloads or error messages for failed downloads
the response does not invent hidden caption text when extraction is blocked

evals.prompt: Use $url-reader to read http://localhost:3000/private and explain the result.
evals.expected_output: The script refuses to fetch private or local URLs and returns a structured Failed result instead of sending the URL to an external reader.
assertions: reader_status is Failed
reader_backend is null
error explains that localhost, private, or internal host URLs are refused
no network fetch is attempted for the target URL

evals.prompt: Use $url-reader to read an Instagram Reel URL that resolves to an Instagram login page.
evals.expected_output: The script reports reader_status Blocked for the Reel login wall, does not preserve login-page assets as usable images, and supplies a structured reason for downstream unresolved-source handling.
assertions: instagram.com/reel/... login pages return reader_status Blocked
status_reason mentions the Instagram Reel login wall
login-page static assets are not returned as usable image_links
ordinary instagram.com/p/... posts are not blocked by this rule

evals.prompt: Use $url-reader to read a public article URL whose generic reader and Browser4 fallback cannot extract the body.
evals.expected_output: The script preserves the best structured result and emits a mandatory in-app Browser handoff instead of silently ending at Browser4.
assertions: browser_fallback.required is true
browser_fallback.surface is in_app_browser
browser_fallback.canonical_url is the normalized public URL
the handoff is not emitted for a complete Extracted result
